caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing human figure seen in profile view facing left. The figure has brown skin and long dark hair, wearing a large, elaborate headdress with red, green, and white feathers arranged in a fan shape. The figure's attire includes a dark tunic with decorative shoulder and arm pieces in white, yellow, and gold colors, and a short skirt with green trim at the bottom. The figure has gold earrings and a yellow belt with a square buckle at the waist. The hands are holding objects: the right hand holds what appears to be a cylindrical item, while the left hand holds a fringed object. The legs are a lighter brown than the upper body, with anklets or straps shown on both ankles. The feet are placed upon a black rectangular block, which rests on a brown wooden platform, with metal brackets securing the block in place. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored.
title: Cigar Store Indian
